LightningComponentBundle.description: An interactive organization chart with search, expand/collapse and PNG export, powered by d3-org-chart.

property.name: chartObjectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: API name of the object whose records the chart shows, e.g. User or Contact. Without it, the chart shows demo data.

property.name: parentFieldApiName
property.label: Parent Field API Name
property.description: API name of the field with the parent record, e.g. ManagerId for User, ReportsToId for Contact or ParentId for Account.

property.name: nameField
property.label: Name Field
property.description: API name of the field shown as the name of a node.

property.name: titleField
property.label: Title Field
property.description: API name of the field shown below the name, e.g. Title.

property.name: imageField
property.label: Image Field
property.description: API name of the field with an image URL shown instead of the initials, e.g. SmallPhotoUrl for User.

property.name: rootRecordId
property.label: Root Record Id
property.description: Id of the record the chart starts from. Without it, a record page starts from its own record if it is among the loaded records; otherwise the chart shows all of them.
